Answer: A
Reason: The sagittal and axial CT images demonstrate a large, hyperdense collection surrounding the aortic arch and descending thoracic aorta, consistent with a mediastinal hematoma resulting from traumatic aortic injury (dissection/rupture) due to the deceleration mechanism. This hematoma is the direct cause of the observed mediastinal widening.
